targets.query:
SELECT
  non_negative_difference(last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_runtime_hr_total")) AS "MBR Scour Blower 1",
  non_negative_difference(last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Dewatering Feed Pump 1" FROM "plc" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(1d) tz('Asia/Kolkata')

SELECT
  non_negative_difference(last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_runtime_hr_total")) AS "MBR Blower 202-B-01",
  non_negative_difference(last("202_p_02_mbr_backwash_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "MBR Backwash Pump 202-P-02",
  non_negative_difference(last("301_p_01_ro_mcf_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "MCF Feed Pump 301-P-01",
  non_negative_difference(last("301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "RO CIP Pump 301-P-02",
  non_negative_difference(last("301_p_03_caustic_dosing_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Caustic Pump 301-P-03",
  non_negative_difference(last("301_p_04_smbs_dosing_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "SMBS Pump 301-P-04",
  non_negative_difference(last("301_p_05_antiscalant_dosing_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Antiscalant Pump 301-P-05",
  non_negative_difference(last("302_p_01_ro_hp_pump_a_runtime_hr_total")) AS "RO HP Pump A 302-P-01",
  non_negative_difference(last("302_b_01_degasser_blower_a_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Degasser Blower A 302-B-01",
  non_negative_difference(last("302_b_02_degasser_blower_b_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Degasser Blower B 302-B-02",
  non_negative_difference(last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total")) AS "Dewatering Feed Pump 501-P-01" FROM "plc"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(1d) tz('Asia/Kolkata')

SELECT
  last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_runtime_hr_total") AS "MBR Blower 202-B-01",
  last("202_p_02_mbr_backwash_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "MBR Backwash Pump 202-P-02",
  last("301_p_01_ro_mcf_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "MCF Feed Pump 301-P-01",
  last("301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "RO CIP Pump 301-P-02",
  last("301_p_03_caustic_dosing_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "Caustic Pump 301-P-03",
  last("301_p_04_smbs_dosing_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "SMBS Pump 301-P-04",
  last("301_p_05_antiscalant_dosing_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "Antiscalant Pump 301-P-05",
  last("302_p_01_ro_hp_pump_a_runtime_hr_total") AS "RO HP Pump A 302-P-01",
  last("302_b_01_degasser_blower_a_runtime_hr_total") AS "Degasser Blower A 302-B-01",
  last("302_b_02_degasser_blower_b_runtime_hr_total") AS "Degasser Blower B 302-B-02",
  last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_runtime_hr_total") AS "Dewatering Feed Pump 501-P-01" FROM "plc"
WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT
  last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_run_fb") + (last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_trip_fb") * 2) AS "MBR Blower 202-B-01",
  last("202_p_02_mbr_backwash_pump_run_fb") + (last("202_p_02_mbr_backwash_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "MBR Backwash Pump 202-P-02",
  -- RO Feed & Dosing
  last("301_p_01_ro_mcf_feed_pump_run_fb") + (last("301_p_01_ro_mcf_feed_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "MCF Feed Pump 301-P-01",
  last("301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_run_fb") + (last("301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "RO CIP Pump 301-P-02",
  last("301_p_03_caustic_dosing_pump_run_fb") + (last("301_p_03_caustic_dosing_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Caustic Pump 301-P-03",
  last("301_p_04_smbs_dosing_pump_run_fb") + (last("301_p_04_smbs_dosing_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "SMBS Pump 301-P-04",
  last("301_p_05_antiscalant_dosing_pump_run_fb") + (last("301_p_05_antiscalant_dosing_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Antiscalant Pump 301-P-05",
  -- RO & Polishing
  last("302_p_01_ro_hp_pump_a_run_fb") AS "RO HP Pump A 302-P-01",
  last("302_p_02_ro_hp_pump_b_run_fb") AS "RO HP Pump B 302-P-02",
  last("302_b_01_degasser_blower_a_run_fb") + (last("302_b_01_degasser_blower_a_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Degasser Blower A 302-B-01",
  last("302_b_02_degasser_blower_b_run_fb") + (last("302_b_02_degasser_blower_b_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Degasser Blower B 302-B-02",
  -- Dewatering
  last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_run_fb") + (last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_trip_fb") * 2) AS "Dewatering Feed Pump 501-P-01"
FROM "plc"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
